en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a narrow cobblestone street flanked by multi‑story masonry buildings with shutters and balconies. A few pedestrians stand along the right sidewalk. At the far end of the street a lighter building closes the perspective, with hills or mountains faintly visible in the background. Printed caption text appears at the bottom border.
